description.value: Lee's Donuts is a Vancouver institution founded in 1979, originally at Granville Island and now expanded to multiple locations including this Gastown outpost on Water Street. The shop is known for handmade, scratch-made classic donuts — honey dips, jelly-filled, and rotating seasonal flavours — all made fresh daily. Featured on Netflix and beloved by generations of Vancouverites, it's a reliable quick stop for a sweet treat in one of the city's most walkable and bikeable neighbourhoods.
